claims.behavior: The Sirv example answers its health endpoint.
claims.precondition: Owner starts the checked-out Sirv example with npm start on port 43187.
claims.case: Healthy installation; wrong-example installation as a negative control.
claims.observed: Sirv returned HTTP 200 and OK. The same GET /health request rejected the existing Morgan example with 404 Not Found, then passed after owner restored Sirv.

claims.behavior: A guest can open the Sirv example page and read its local stylesheet.
claims.precondition: Sirv owner server restored; exact local origin only.
claims.expected: Page title Example: Sirv, one #app element, and HTTP 200 stylesheet containing #app.
claims.case: Local static content only; external scripts and images are outside this claim.
requiredEvidence: Browser expectations, screenshot and HTTP stylesheet response
claims.observed: At 1280x800, title Example: Sirv and exactly one #app held. GET /style.css returned 200 and #app. One console error and one failed request remain; gallery appearance and external image loading are outside this claim.

controls.observedFailure: Morgan at the same origin returned 404 Not Found and body-contains OK failed.
controls.observedPass: Owner restored Sirv with npm start; identical GET /health expectation returned 200 OK and body-contains OK passed.
controls.expectation: The unchanged health expectation rejects a different existing example installed at the same origin, then passes after owner restores Sirv.

environment.name: source identity
environment.detail: Current source matches the baseline recorded at up.

environment.name: artifact integrity
environment.detail: 16 of 16 recorded artifacts match their checksums.

environment.name: cleanup
environment.detail: Spyglass cleanup: true; external owner cleanup: true.

limits: Agent-only adoption. No human usability conclusion.
No database, login, persistent writes, visual acceptance or external image completion is claimed.
External scripts and Unsplash images are outside the allowed origin; their errors are expected and not hidden.
Repository npm start owns launch. No repository stop or readiness command exists; operator supplies curl readiness and a listener-PID cleanup check without transferring process ownership to Spyglass.
The control swaps between two existing examples at the same port without editing source; this proves wrong-target detection, not a code-mutation defect.
Legacy dependency audit findings are retained; dependencies are not repaired in this adoption.

The existing no-input URL assertion now requires TypeError instead of old Node message wording. Its original Node 24 failure is retained; no separate source-mutation control was added for this compatibility repair.
